claim: Patchline guards its gate scripts against non-portable shell constructs so that gates run identically on macOS bash 3.2 and Linux without relying on GNU-only or interactive-only features. The worker lints a set of scripts for a catalog of portability hazards — mapfile, /tmp writes, GNU sed -i without a backup suffix, and process substitution into mapfile — and reports any hits. The gate proves the shipped portability-sensitive scripts are clean against the hazard catalog while a deliberately non-portable negative-control snippet is flagged for every hazard it contains.
real_repo: patchline (self): shell portability lint over gate scripts
